title: darrylmorley/whatcable
claim: darrylmorley/whatcable — macOS menu bar app that tells you, in plain English, what each USB-C cable plugged into your Mac can actually do
why_good: As USB-C becomes the universal standard, users face confusion about cable capabilities, creating a need for clarity.
value: Consumers could pay for a premium version with advanced features, while manufacturers might pay for analytics on cable usage.
risk: Apple or other hardware manufacturers could integrate similar functionality into their systems, diminishing the app's unique value.
